why: Shannon's demon / rebalancing premium: a periodically rebalanced basket earns FROM volatility even when price goes nowhere - long-only, no shorting. This is the literature's direct answer to earning in sideways markets, and the flat years are exactly where our worst year lives. The known killer is fees, so rebalancing must be infrequent (daily/weekly), never per-bar.

THE direct test of the structural diagnosis. The trend filter is a hard VETO inside OracleNN, so in bear and sideways years the book is EMPTY - exposure 1-9% - and the worst year is therefore bounded near zero by construction. No sizing, gating or money-management lever can change that, because they all act on trades the system chooses to take. trend_soft turns the veto into a dimmer: a down-trend name may be entered at a fraction of normal size. This asks the only question that matters - is trading the flat years small profitable, or is standing aside genuinely correct?

expect: if a small position through downtrends earns anything in 2022 and 2025, the worst year lifts off zero, which is worth more under the consistency law than every lever measured so far combined; if it loses, the flat-book design is correct and the operator should be told that plainly

why: P06 showed the sizing formula is deploy = position_fraction + (regime_deploy - position_fraction) * breadth_score, with each position sized equity * deploy / max_positions. So position_fraction is the bear-market FLOOR and max_positions a DIVISOR; the only knob that raises the book in GOOD conditions is regime_deploy, the ceiling, and no arm has ever varied it. This sweeps it while holding max_positions=2 and position_fraction=0.15 fixed, so the bear floor stays where it is - which matters, because raising that floor breached the mandate in 2018.

question: Do labels that certify survival of OUR exit machinery (triple barrier with the books stop 8pct / trail 12pct / 10d vertical, min gain 1pct) produce a net whose candidates stop dying on stops - the generation lift no filter or sizing change has produced?
judge: Reconciliation first: baseline variant must reproduce ~0.0738/0.0724 (P15 confirmed the shape). Signature of success: thin-year (2022/23/25) per-year deltas positive - raw-rule gross profit appearing where there is none - or at minimum a clear mean lift toward the +0.0391 bar with seeds agreeing. Kill: class-balance is fine (36-44pct positives measured), so the honest kill is that path labels merely reproduce what the meta filter already learns downstream - visible as a lift that vanishes when the meta filter is active in scoring (shipping config includes meta 0.005, so the scored delta ALREADY answers this).
